headline: As of 2026-11-03: 63,408,989 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+7.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 63,408,989 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+7.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (8,007,743), Florida (7,575,112), California (7,202,817).
